pages.text: $(lilomon)$(#503a30)Dont be blinded by his fury, for he still my sweet brother. Protect yourself, but dont take my pain. My memories are not for such a weight.
$(lilomon)$(#503a30)Please, if you see my brother... Please remember to say for me "Sorry I hurt you, but i also forgive you" to him. If mercy is possible, please... dont mistake it for weakness
